text:
marta: heads-up, I'm hitting a shape mismatch in the sample-app when using the async Python client for embeddings + reranking. Sync path works.

sam: repro steps?

marta: repo: github.com/redwood/sample-apps/vec-search, branch=fix-async
error: TypeError: 'float' object is not subscriptable
snippet:
```
# using AsyncEmbedClient.batch
resp = await client.embed_batch(["q1","q2"])
# expected: resp[0]['embedding'] -> list[float]
# actual: resp -> [[...], [...]] (list of lists)
```

alex: ok that sounds like the old parity bug. I think sync client returns list of dicts, async returns raw list. also rerank returns {'scores': [..]} vs [{'id':..., 'score':...}]

nina: can you paste the raw payload from the server? is K/V cache or batching layer changing payload envelope?

marta: pasted minimal server response:
```
{"data": [{"embedding": [0.12, 0.03, ...]}, {"embedding": [...]}], "model":"open-embed-v1"}
```
but the async SDK layer returns:
```
[[0.12,0.03,...],[...]]
```

devx-bot: FYI opened issue #418: python-sdk: async embed batcher: response envelope parity mismatch

sam: also saw retries cause intermittent 401 when batching many small requests -> auth header dropped in retry branch. @eng-platform any ideas?

lee: that retry bug is in our aiohttp wrapper — we reauthorize only on 401 when request has 'auth_retry' flag; batching uses a pooled session without flag. Fix will be small.

marta: small patch attached in PR 542, adds envelope unwrapping and stricter typing in stub: returns List[Dict[str, List[float]]]

alex: can we add a batching helper util in sample-apps that normalizes both shapes? e.g., ensure_client_response(resp) -> List[Dict]

nina: yes please. also add unit + typing tests. add async+sync fixture in pytest.

sam: plan: 1) patch SDK to unify envelope (semantic parity) 2) fix aiohttp retry auth bug 3) add sample-app helper + tests 4) release patch 0.8.3

marta: thanks all. I'll iterate on PR and add a small migration note in sample app README.

lee: :thumbsup:

marta: closing loop, landed fix in sdk/main, sample-app changed to use ensure_client_response helper. observed consistent shapes in both sync+async. tagging docs/CHANGELOG.
